title: Reviser: Revision-Capable Text Generation via Autoregressive Cursor Actions
abstract: arXiv:2609.20830v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Revision-capable generation is appealing because it can insert or revise earlier content, but many non-autoregressive and edit-based approaches obtain this flexibility through repeated sequence-level computation. We propose Reviser, a decoder-only Transformer that generates a response as a sequence of cursor-relative actions on a mutable canvas. At each step, Reviser predicts exactly one action token: INSERT(token), MOVE($\Delta$), or STOP, and is autoregressive over edit-history actions rather than final text order. This design enables genuinely non-monotonic generation while preserving a simple next-action interface. On a continuation benchmark, Reviser is strongly preferred to SEDD and MDLM in our arena evaluations, and trajectory statistics confirm that the model performs frequent backward moves and mid-canvas insertions rather than merely emulating end-append decoding. translated_title: Reviser：通过自回归光标动作实现可修订的文本生成
translated_abstract: 具备修订能力的生成非常有吸引力，因为它可以插入或修改先前已生成的内容，但许多非自回归和基于编辑的方法需要通过重复的序列级计算来获得这种灵活性。我们提出了 Reviser，一个仅解码器的 Transformer，它将生成过程建模为在可变画布上的一系列光标相对动作。在每一步，Reviser 精确预测一个动作标记：INSERT(token)（插入）、MOVE($\Delta$)（移动）或 STOP（停止），并且是对编辑历史动作而非最终文本顺序进行自回归。这种设计实现了真正的非单调生成，同时保持了简单的“下一动作”接口。在一个续写基准测试中，在我们的竞技场评估里 Reviser 明显优于 SEDD 和 MDLM，且轨迹统计证实该模型确实频繁执行向后移动和画布中部插入，而不仅仅是模拟末尾追加式的解码。与规模匹配的自回归基线相比，Reviser 具有……（原文在此截断）
tldr: Reviser 提出了一种仅解码器 Transformer，通过在可变画布上自回归地预测光标动作（插入、移动、停止）实现真正非单调的可修订文本生成，在保持简单下一动作接口的同时避免了重复的序列级计算，性能优于 SEDD 和 MDLM 等扩散模型。
en_tdlr: Reviser is a decoder-only Transformer that achieves genuinely non-monotonic, revision-capable text generation by autoregressively predicting cursor actions (INSERT, MOVE, STOP) on a mutable canvas, outperforming diffusion models like SEDD and MDLM while avoiding repeated sequence-level computation.
